statement: The proportion of SUID cases with inadequate postpartum healthcare access is higher compared to non-SUID infant deaths within the same period.
rationale: This study uses a case-case comparison design, comparing SUID cases and other infant deaths from the NCFRP dataset. PRAMS data provides information on postpartum healthcare access for mothers of live births, allowing for comparisons between these groups.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C10 [limitation] notes that postnatal exposures are excluded, while bedsharing_ms_v7.C24 [limitation] highlights the surveillance nature of case series data. These limitations indicate a need to investigate postpartum healthcare access specifically.
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish causation or incidence due to its observational nature and lack of denominator data.
